acceptance_predicates.description: Omitted channel resolves to dev and persists across a fresh process.
Install, status, launch, upgrade, rollback, and remove expose the same channel option and human/--json semantics.
Unknown or unavailable channels return typed diagnostics without silently falling back.
Development-only authentication, signatures, and key management remain warning-only.

definition_of_done: Focused unit and subprocess tests pass at the exact head.
Independent review confirms current-main dev provenance and unchanged production policy.

inputs.description: Supported channel vocabulary and persisted default.

gates.description: All lifecycle commands agree on default, explicit, and unavailable channels.
